description: Mostly an opening detector. It fires most strongly at ply 3 (second player to move) when the opponent's two stones are in the centre (cols 3-5, including col 4) and my stone is in col 4 or the opponent holds col 4 too, and less often at ply 5. A stone of mine in col 1 switches it off. About 70% of firing is scattered, near-threshold mid/late-game positions with no pattern I could find.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by at most 0.03 on 4 positions.
notes: Ply-3 enumeration (343 openings) showed the pattern: strong when col 4 is involved and the opponent has 2 centre stones (5,4,3 = 1.94). ply==3 alone gave F1 0.21; table-based rule F1 0.346; restricting ply 5 to last move in cols 3-5 gave F1 0.363 (P 0.58, R 0.26), sim share 0.07. Late-game firing: last-move col, capping, column-top owner, heights, per-column colour counts all only weakly different; activations swing with small colour changes. Synthesis: opponent centre stones plus my 3-stack in col 6 capped by the opponent reach 2.50 (dev max 2.21). The extremes being in the opening plus no steering effect suggest this may be a random direction.
